author: TeIq
content:
## Source
.design/m5/46-ozone-migration.md — REQ-5, AC-6 + decomposition PR 6.

## Surface
- After a successful import, the binary writes ONE explicit audit-log entry:
  ```json
  {
    "kind": "ozone-migration-boundary",
    "action_count": <N>,
    "source_checksum": "<sha256 hex>",
    "at": "<RFC3339 timestamp>"
  }
  ```
- The v1 hash chain (`design.md` §6) ingests this naturally — it accepts any structured payload.
- Case-view query path: when displaying a subject's history timeline, the case-view DTO joins both Polaris-native `actions` AND migrated `actions WHERE migrated_from_ozone_event_id IS NOT NULL`. The timeline renders both, with migrated actions visually annotated ("imported from Ozone").

## Rust-quality notes
- Migrated actions are NOT in the hash chain proper (per design). The chain starts at the migration-boundary entry. Pre-migration history is visible but not chained — clearly communicated in the case view annotation.
- **The annotation is the privacy/integrity contract**: migrated actions show "imported from Ozone" in red/warning color so moderators understand the integrity story.
- Per rust-quality §1: the audit-log entry's `kind` field uses an enum (or `&'static str` constant) — never a free-form string literal.
- Frontend rendering: extend `polaris-frontend/src/components/history_timeline.rs` with a `migrated_marker` field on each timeline entry. CSS class `.history-timeline__entry--migrated` for the visual treatment.
- Per rust-quality §3: handler errors from "join migrated actions" path fall back to "show native actions only" rather than break the case view.

## External references
- v1 audit log impl: `polaris-backend/src/audit/`
- v1 history timeline: `polaris-frontend/src/components/history_timeline.rs`

## Acceptance (AC-6)
- [ ] After a successful migration, querying the audit log around the boundary timestamp returns the explicit `ozone-migration-boundary` entry with the row count + checksum.
- [ ] Case view of a migrated subject shows the historical Ozone actions with "imported from Ozone" annotation.
- [ ] Hash-chain verification spans pre-boundary native entries → migration-boundary entry → post-boundary native entries, with all chain hashes verifying.

## Blocks / blocked-by
- Blocked by #139.
- Blocks #141 (runbook documents the audit-trail story).
